title: [maintainer] Should `AGENTS.md` carry the rule that a "verified" claim is only as good as the check that re-verifies it every commit? — five measured instances this round
body:
Filed by the PM seat out of PR objectui#7831 (card objectui#7505). ⛔ **The `domain:ui` dispatch lane cannot do this**: `AGENTS.md` is a governed surface, and an agent seat neither edits nor approves one. This card exists so the rule is not lost.

## The rule, as the #7505 seat wrote it

> **A claim that something was verified is only as good as the check that re-verifies it on every commit.**

It is already recorded **verbatim in `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`'s header and pinned by a test** so it cannot drift out of that source. What is proposed here is only whether it also belongs in `AGENTS.md`, where it would reach authors who are not editing that gate.

## Why it generalises — four same-shaped instances measured this round

| instance | the claim | how it went false |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **objectui#7505** (the origin) | a `declared` doc fragment marked *"checked against the shipped `dist/index.d.ts`"* | the gate **structurally cannot** compile a `declared` fragment, so nothing ever re-checked it. ⭐ It was false **twice**: once when PR objectui#7503 widened the return type, and again — measured at the moment the seat read it — because the excerpt was missing `systemCapabilities?: string[]` (ADR-0066) |
| **objectui#7528** | *"one total over **52** chunks"* in present-tense prose | three different counts in play: prose 52, the file's own `BASELINE.chunks` 48, the gate's live output 50 |
| **objectui#7362** | a fix list enumerated by name | entries expired as they were fixed; nothing re-derived the list |
| **objectui#7433** | a population count | rotted **three** times |

⭐ And a fifth, from objectui#7448 (PR objectui#7827), which is the sharpest illustration of why "spot-check it" does not save you:

> `184 pages (144 .mdx + 40 .md)` was not merely stale — `content/docs/**` holds **exactly** 184 files split **exactly** 144 + 40 **today**. It is a precisely correct count of the population the gate **stopped having**. A reader who spot-checked it would have confirmed it and still been wrong about the scan surface.

⇒ The failure mode is not "someone wrote a wrong number". It is **a true-when-written assertion that no instrument re-derives**, which is indistinguishable from a live one at every later reading.

## What is being asked

A maintainer decision on whether `AGENTS.md` should carry this rule, and in what words. ⚠️ Not a request to write it — ⛔ this lane will not edit `AGENTS.md` under any framing.

⭐ If it does land, the shape the repo has already converged on independently, three times, is worth naming in it: **a pointer to the instrument's own output, never a copy of the instrument's answer** (`check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`'s `UNGATED_DOCS` header was itself repaired into *"a pointer to the list now rather than a copy of its length"*; PR objectui#7827 applied the same shape to two workflow headers and added a pin that refuses a numeral qualifying a document-population noun — ⭐ its ablation injected a **completely correct** literal and the pin still refused it, proving the pin governs the *class of writing*, not "wrong numbers").

Related: objectui#7505 · PR objectui#7831 · objectui#7448 · PR objectui#7827 · objectui#7528 · objectui#7362 · objectui#7433
